## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: A ten-word TODO with no actionable content lands in the ask-a-human tier and...

The system SHALL ensure that a ten-word TODO with no actionable content lands in the ask-a-human tier and a terse but actionable one does not, covered by fixtures in skills/tests/fix-scrub.

#### Scenario: A ten-word TODO with no actionable content lands in the ask-a-human tier and...

WHEN `judge-fix-tier-classification-in-fix-scrub` is implemented
THEN A ten-word TODO with no actionable content lands in the ask-a-human tier and a terse but actionable one does not, covered by fixtures in skills/tests/fix-scrub.

### Requirement: _is_ruff_fixable still classifies by ruff rule prefix with no decision call,...

The system SHALL ensure that _is_ruff_fixable still classifies by ruff rule prefix with no decision call, asserted by a call-count test.

#### Scenario: _is_ruff_fixable still classifies by ruff rule prefix with no decision call,...

WHEN `judge-fix-tier-classification-in-fix-scrub` is implemented
THEN _is_ruff_fixable still classifies by ruff rule prefix with no decision call, asserted by a call-count test.

### Requirement: The character-count and substring rules remain the fallback and existing...

The system SHALL ensure that the character-count and substring rules remain the fallback and existing classify tests pass with the helper stubbed to None.

#### Scenario: The character-count and substring rules remain the fallback and existing...

WHEN `judge-fix-tier-classification-in-fix-scrub` is implemented
THEN The character-count and substring rules remain the fallback and existing classify tests pass with the helper stubbed to None.
